title: The specified iteration, return words and scalar-calculus predicates
statement: For the finite-field and coefficient data of the scalar-calculus statement, use the exact recursive functors, point maps, power compositors and scalar comparisons in the attached Lean definitions. iterate has zero term identity and successor iterate followed by U; pointIterate has zero identity and successor followed by iota; scalarIterate has zero identity and successor alpha followed by the image of its preceding term. finiteReturn, integralReturn and rationalReturn are the two normalized compositor words joined by the specified equality of scheme maps. Their point transports compose the point iteration with fibre of this return comparison. The predicates collect naturality, the return scalar square, the point scalar square, and actual identity and coefficient-tower laws. These are the existing definitions of the assigned node, moved verbatim into a definition-only module so lower statements can mention them without a cyclic import.
